title: Technical Communication and Handoffs
summary: Turn technical observations into concise, useful handoffs.
objectives: Separate observations, assumptions, and confirmed findings.
Write a concise status update and escalation note.

vocab.def: Information passed to another person or team so work can continue safely.
What the available evidence does not yet establish.

sections.heading: Make the record useful
sections.body: A handoff names the system, time, observation, evidence, action, and uncertainty. It avoids blame and avoids claiming a cause that has not been confirmed.

sections.heading: A reliable pattern
sections.body: Use: what happened, what was observed, what was checked, what remains unknown, and what the next authorized person should do.

practice.prompt: Rewrite 'the server is broken' as a useful handoff.
practice.answer: At 10:15, the synthetic service alert is active; network link is normal; cause is unknown; please investigate using the approved procedure.

quiz.question: Which statement is an observation?
options: The temperature reading is 31°C and rising
quiz.answer: The temperature reading is 31°C and rising

lab.objective: Write a factual technical handoff from synthetic status information.

reflectionPrompt: What detail makes a technical handoff easier for the next person to trust?
